item.title: The bankstatementparser suite is live on PyPI
item.description: Parse CAMT, MT940/942, BAI2, OFX/QFX, CSV and PDF into one auditable Transaction model. Core plus loaders, an XLSX writer, an LSP server and an MCP server — all Apache-2.0.
